<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/feature-split.ts -->
<!--
  Features beside a picture. Axes: layout (grid: four plain features in two columns, cards: four features as
  cards and the actions, stats: two figure cards over three checked rows beside a square picture, metrics: four
  metric cards and the actions), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
import type { LinkActions } from "./error-page.types";

export type FeatureSplitProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  lead?: string;
  badge?: string;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  features: Feature[];
  stats: Stat[];
  actions: LinkActions;
  layout?: "grid" | "cards" | "stats" | "metrics";
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import FeatureCards from "../components/feature-cards.vue";
import FeatureMetricCards from "../components/feature-metric-cards.vue";
import FeaturePairs from "../components/feature-pairs.vue";
import FeatureStatRows from "../components/feature-stat-rows.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";

const {
  id,
  title,
  lead = "",
  badge = "",
  level = 2,
  features,
  stats,
  actions,
  layout = "grid",
  mediaSide = "end",
  tone = "default",
} = defineProps<FeatureSplitProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="lead"
    :heading="{ badge, level }"
    :tone="tone"
    layout="split"
    :media="{ show: true, side: mediaSide }"
  >
    <FeaturePairs v-if="((layout as string) === 'grid')" :features="features" />
    <FeatureCards v-if="((layout as string) === 'cards')" :features="features" cols="1-2" item="tile" />
    <FeatureStatRows v-if="((layout as string) === 'stats')" :features="features" :stats="stats" />
    <FeatureMetricCards v-if="((layout as string) === 'metrics')" :stats="stats" />
    <ActionGroup v-if="(((layout as string) === 'cards') || ((layout as string) === 'metrics'))"
      :primary="actions.cta"
      :primaryHref="actions.href"
      :secondary="((actions.mode === 'two') ? actions.secondary : undefined)"
      :secondaryHref="actions.secondaryHref"
      align="start"
    />
    <template #aside>
      <MediaFrame :alt="title" :ratio="(((layout as string) === 'stats') ? '1/1' : '4/3')" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
